purpose: Generate all16 complete-system trajectory summaries through the shared prepared-text controller/executor. Preserve all sources including ties; actual feedback is supplied only to a later separately registered comparison.
read_rule: Read only operational/closure metadata until all four registered summary sources finalize; then register scientific reading and reverify each summary-to-actor binding. Empty, capped, malformed and unusable outputs are retained and quarantined; no silent retry.
failure_policy: This is the sole named successor for the summary launch. Stop on any further execution failure; no second recovery or automatic restart.
downstream: No comparison, group update, batch synthesis, runtime memory activation or next actor launch is admitted by this protocol.
named_repair: The v1 root admission omitted schema=saea-campaign-decision-v1. The campaign held before attempts, fits or generation. This successor fixes only decision custody and uses fresh run identities; source requests, output reserve, service and science are unchanged.
